package.name: chase_gym
package.description:
Tier A of the three-tier simulator architecture (docs/drone_chasing_rl/sim_training_architecture.md): the point-kinematics image-plane chase environment where ALL gradient training runs, plus the shared contract modules (observation assembly, reward, latency queue, detector-corruption model, pinhole projection) that Tiers B/C and the deployment nodes import unchanged.
Pure Python: no module here imports a ROS symbol (rl_training_guide.md section 15). It is an ament package only so colcon installs it next to the ROS packages that import it. Pip deps without rosdep keys: gymnasium (verified 1.x), numpy.
